name: youj-theme-brutal
title: Brutal theme stylesheet
description: The Brutal theme's stylesheet, for an app that themes with attributes (data-yj-theme="brutal" on <html>, as a Vite or Astro app does). The preset itself (brutal) is in the core already: import styles from lib/youj/theme/themes/brutal.css after youj.css. A theme set with <YoujProvider theme={brutal}> or themeProps needs no stylesheet.

name: youj-theme-check
title: Theme check
description: Development guardrails for themes: checkTheme, themeErrors, checkRoles and the console warning YoujProvider logs for a theme that misses contrast. The core ships a no-op in its place, since production builds strip the check. Import from lib/youj/theme/check.
